detail_name: TorchVision ViT-B-16 ImageNet-1K V1 training details
notes: TorchVision ViT-B-16 V1 recipe uses repeated augmentation sampler and model EMA; weight transforms use 224 crop with ImageNet normalization.

detail_name: SWAG ViT-B/16 ImageNet-1K end-to-end fine-tuning details
notes: SWAG ViT-B/16 ImageNet-1K fine-tuned checkpoint uses 384x384 bicubic preprocessing in TorchVision metadata; end-to-end fine-tuned checkpoint should not be treated as head-only feature extraction.

detail_name: TorchVision ViT-B-16 ImageNet-pretrained custom fine-tuning details
notes: Use weights.transforms() for validation/inference. For custom classes replace heads.head; for small datasets freeze encoder and train heads.head first; interpolate positional embeddings when changing image size.

detail_name: FT-CLIP CLIP ViT-B/16 ImageNet-1K fine-tuning details
notes: FT-CLIP fine-tunes the visual encoder for ImageNet-1K using CLIP mean/std, RandAug, no MixUp/CutMix, no drop path, layer-wise LR decay, and EMA.

detail_name: Adapted timm CLIP ViT-B/16 custom fine-tuning details
notes: The 224px crop, bicubic interpolation, 248px evaluation resize and CLIP normalization match the timm pretrained configuration. Label smoothing and random erasing are retained from FT-CLIP; exact FT-CLIP RandAug is omitted rather than approximated by a different policy.

detail_name: TorchVision Swin V2 ImageNet-1K training details
notes: TorchVision Swin V2 Tiny and Small use resize 260 and crop 256. The final classifier is model.head in TorchVision SwinTransformer.

detail_name: Adapted Swin V2 Tiny ImageNet V1 custom fine-tuning details
notes: Replace model.head for custom labels; optionally warm up the head with a frozen backbone; then update all parameters and use the exact V1 weights transforms for validation/inference.

detail_name: Adapted Swin V2 Small ImageNet V1 custom fine-tuning details
notes: Replace model.head for custom labels; optionally warm up the head with a frozen backbone; then update all parameters and use the exact V1 weights transforms for validation/inference.

detail_name: Meta DINOv2 ImageNet-1K frozen linear evaluation details
notes: Official DINOv2 linear evaluation freezes the pretrained backbone and trains a supervised linear classifier on ImageNet-1K; eval configs use global_crops_size=518 for pretrained backbones.

detail_name: Hugging Face DINOv2 custom image-classification fine-tuning details
notes: DINOv2 image processor resizes shortest edge to 256, center-crops to 224, rescales, and applies ImageNet normalization; Dinov2ForImageClassification adds a linear classifier on top of the CLS token.

detail_name: Adapted timm DINOv2 Small/Base custom fine-tuning details
notes: Training uses a 224px random crop; validation, testing, evaluation, and inference use deterministic 256px resize and 224px center crop with bicubic interpolation and ImageNet normalization. timm's head is a linear classifier over the pooled class-token representation.
